title: Charts for a summary
description: At most three small charts and one schematic, only where the text gives comparable figures or dated steps. An empty list is a good answer.

type.description: bars: compare two to eight values in one unit. series: one quantity at three or more points in order (years, steps). timeline: two or more dated periods or events. flow: a schematic of two to seven steps or conditions in order, showing how a rule works or who qualifies.

unit.description: bars and series: the single unit of every value, e.g. Rs/kWh, MW, %

note.description: one line a reader needs to read the chart correctly, e.g. whose figures these are

detail.description: flow: the condition or what happens at this step, with the figure from the text

otherwise.description: flow: what follows if this condition is not met

tag.description: bars: what kind of figure this is when they differ, e.g. adopted, not adopted, ceiling, petitioner's claim

context.description: true for a figure shown only for comparison (drawn muted)
